newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 1997 steel output seen at 6.5 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania 1997 steel output seen at 6.5 mln tonnes.

text.p: Romania expects to produce some 6.5 million tonnes of steel in 1997, up from 5.8 million last year amid plans to revamp the state-run sector, a senior official said on Friday.

Ion Capota, Industry Ministry director in charge of the metallurgical sector, said steel output was 1.305 million tonnes over January-March compared with one million over the same period last year. Preliminary data for April put steel output at 521,000 tonnes, he told Reuters.
Under a government-sponsored reorganisation project aimed at bringing the steel sector up to Western standards, steel capacity would be up to 10 million tonnes a year by the year 2005, he said.

Capota said steel plants had over the past year gradually shifted to specialised production including steel tubes, cold-laminated steel plates and alloys, while cutting output of primary products to harmonise output with the demands of the European Union market and regulations.
Romania is an associate member of the EU and is aiming for full membership. --Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
